enchantments.tooltip: Nullification +145: Passive: +145 Equipment bonus to Negative (Necrotic) and Poison Spell Power.
Insightful Nullification +72: Passive: +72 Insightful bonus to Negative (Necrotic) and Poison Spell Power.
Void Lore +21: Passive: Your Negative Energy and Poison spells gain a 21% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Insightful Necromancy Focus +3: +3 Insight bonus to the DC of Necromancy spells.
Devotion +145: Passive: +145 Equipment bonus to Positive (Healing) Spell Power.
Insightful Devotion +72: Passive: +72 Insightful bonus to Positive (Healing) Spell Power.
Healing Lore +21: Passive: Your Positive Energy spells gain a 21% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Efficient Metamagic - Empower Healing II: The additional spell point cost for using the Empower Healing Metamagic feat is reduced by 2 SP.
Spellcasting Implement +28: Passive: +28 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
